init_distributed_mode: init distributed training mode for PyTorch across multiple GPUs using NCCL backend
get_world_size: get the total number of processes in the distributed training group
get_rank: get the current process rank in the distributed training group
is_main_process: check if the current process is the main process with rank zero
is_dist_avail_and_initialized: check if PyTorch distributed is available and initialized for multi-GPU training
